mapper.insert: insert into summary (id, pid, type, class, info, time, goods, attr, warehouse, batch, mfd, direction, price, nums, uct, bct, exist, balance, handle) values (#{id}, #{pid}, #{type}, #{cls}, #{info}, #{time}, #{goods}, #{attr}, #{warehouse}, #{batch}, #{mfd}, #{direction}, #{price}, #{nums}, #{uct}, #{bct}, #{exist}, #{balance}, #{handle})
